QF.id: AIFM CIII Governance and Due Diligence_18

question.text: What is the SEBI-prescribed timeline for an AIF Manager to redress an investor grievance under the SEBI (Facilitation of Grievance Redressal Mechanism) (Amendment) Regulations, 2023?

answer.text: 21 calendar days from receipt of grievance

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the 2023 amendment, AIF Managers shall redress investor grievances within 21 calendar days from the date of receipt of the grievance. Complaints are lodged via SCORES and the Action Taken Report (ATR) is auto-routed. The Trap: 7 days is too aggressive; 90 days confuses with other timelines; 'next financial year' is absurd. Cross-Exam Context: Same timeline in XIX-C/D. XIX-B distributors test the SCORES mechanism from a point-of-sale angle. Review timelines (15 days for first review etc.) are common trap distractors. Manager's Pro-Tip: Log every investor email that smells like a complaint (even 'concern/query') into a complaint register with day-zero timestamp — the 21-day clock starts on receipt, not on categorisation. Missing the ATR window triggers automatic escalation to SEBI via SCORES.
